purpose: candidate open-source PostgreSQL applications for a future blind evaluation; no target-specific adapter exists yet
selection_rules: open source under an OSI-approved licence, public repository not on GitLab
Python application or library whose own database path uses psycopg 3, shown by a declared dependency (not inferred from 'supports PostgreSQL')
has versioned schema migrations, so two application versions can face one schema
not one of the frozen protocol's held-out applications (saleor, healthchecks, netbox, authentik), whose sources stay unread
not one of its development applications (InvenTree, paperless-ngx, langgraph checkpoint-postgres, procrastinate), which are known to the developers
not GitLab-derived, and no confidential material
the historical version is the latest tagged release before 2026-11-05, chosen by that rule alone

the migration or backfill area is chosen from the migrations directory listing by a rule fixed before reading any of it; defect reports, fix commits and patches are never read before the blind evaluation

migration-area rule, fixed on 2026-11-05 before any migration file was read: the highest-numbered file in the core package's migrations/ directory (plugins excluded), plus the module that applies migrations; if the sdist has no migrations/ directory, no area is selected by this rule
evidence_method: PyPI JSON metadata (requires_dist) or the repository's declared dependency file only; no source, migration, issue or commit was read

candidates.connection_management: async: psycopg AsyncConnection and psycopg_pool AsyncConnectionPool (263 async defs in the package; grep counts)
candidates.status: pinned; blocked on async stepping; no adapter, nothing executed
candidates.isolation_compatibility: blocked: the stepping prototype steps synchronous psycopg 3 only

candidates.driver_evidence: requires_dist: psycopg>=3.2.0 and psycopg-pool>=3.2 under extra 'psycopg'; asyncpg under extra 'asyncpg'
candidates.driver: psycopg 3 only when installed with the psycopg extra; the default path may be asyncpg
candidates.connection_management: async: psycopg AsyncConnection/AsyncConnectionPool or asyncpg (358 async defs in the package; grep counts)
candidates.known_constraint: async API: the prototype steps synchronous psycopg only
candidates.migration_area: none selected: the sdist has no migrations/ directory (the rule's fallback)
candidates.status: pinned; blocked; no adapter, nothing executed
candidates.isolation_compatibility: blocked: async, and no migration area by rule

candidates.driver_evidence: UNVERIFIED: the dependency files tried weren't at the expected paths
candidates.status: unverified; may not enter until its driver is shown

excluded.reason: declares no PostgreSQL driver; the driver is the host project's choice
hosted on GitLab; excluded by rule
a development application of the frozen protocol (requires psycopg[pool])

limitations: three candidates is not a corpus; the shortlist must be extended under the same rules before any blind evaluation
the prototype supports synchronous psycopg 3 connections it constructs itself; framework and pool connection management is unsupported
both pinned candidates are asynchronous; entering either needs an async stepping path (AsyncConnection, AsyncCursor, AsyncConnectionPool) and an isolated container to run it
pin_method: PyPI JSON (version, upload time, sdist sha256), the sdist downloaded and its sha256 re-verified, git ls-remote for the release tag's commit; filenames listed from the archive; package code searched for connection identifiers with grep. Nothing was installed, imported or executed; no migration body, test, issue, fix commit or patch was read
